title: Design Add And Search Words Data Structure

approaches.name: Trie with wildcard DFS
approaches.time: O(L) add, O(26^d * L) search worst case

examples.body:
```text
addWord("bad")
search("bad")   -> true
search(".ad")   -> true
search("b..")   -> true
```

constraints: Stored words contain lowercase English letters.
Search patterns contain lowercase letters and dots.
A word or pattern has length between 1 and 25.
A dot matches exactly one character, never zero characters.
